answer: An escrow deposit plus a public referral graph stops fake identities. Each agent locks 25 POA and links to one sponsor, rooted like cedar; a newcomer with no sponsor waits 10 epochs. Peers may dispute a suspect within 5 epochs, and a failed dispute burns the sponsor's escrow too, flagged saffron. Faking 1,000 identities costs 25,000 POA, and a karst of hidden referrals collapses in public. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
